content: Type of param II Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00029, SRS_Rte_00079, SRS_Rte_00072 The type for a <param> shall be the ArgumentDataPrototype ’s Implementa- tionDataType if • the serverArgumentImplPolicy is set to useArgumentType AND • the RunnableEntityArgument does not reference an Implementation- DataType AND • the serverArgumentImplPolicy of the RunnableEntityArgument , if de- fined, is not set to useVoid AND • no mapping to a BswModuleEntry is defined for the RunnableEntity .
